description: This file contains a set of unit tests for the EmailQueueDao class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing email retrieval, saving emails, removing emails from the queue, and fetching pending email IDs.

classes.name: EmailQueueDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for EmailQueueDao, testing email queue operations such as retrieval, saving, deletion, and fetching pending email IDs.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating an instance of EmailQueueDao, setting up fixtures, and kernel initialization.

methods.name: testGetEmail
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of an email by ID from the email queue.

methods.name: testSaveEmail
methods.description: Tests the creation and saving of a new email in the queue.

methods.name: testRemoveFromQueue
methods.description: Tests removing email IDs from the queue.

methods.name: testGetAllPendingMailIds
methods.description: Tests fetching all IDs of pending emails.
